headline: Airtel becomes India's most valuable brand while Wall Street slips despite Anthropic debut

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Airtel overtook HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand.
Wall Street ended lower as Anthropic's debut failed to sustain broader AI market momentum.
Tata Trusts scheduled a board meeting with Tata Sons IPO listing absent from the agenda.
Multiple major domestic equities including Coal India, Paytm, and Voltas are listed in stock watch updates.
whatHappening: Airtel surpassed HDFC Bank as the top brand in India according to a report.
Anthropic stock closed higher on its first day of trading on Wall Street.
Tata Trusts convenes its board meeting on November 20.
Indian markets remain open today with several stocks under watch.
summary:
Airtel has overtaken HDFC Bank to become the most valuable brand in India.
Wall Street closed lower overall even as Anthropic saw gains during its trading debut.
Indian markets are open today with key focus on stocks like Coal India, Paytm, Voltas, and JK Cement.
